title: Mitigating Gender Bias via Fostering Exploratory Thinking in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating prediction mismatches in moral judgments of male versus female characters (GenMO dataset), testing coreference resolution accuracy for gendered pronouns in occupational contexts (WinoBias dataset), and assessing reliance on social stereotypes in multiple-choice question answering (BBQ dataset).
